title: Towards population-specific brain charts across the lifespan
title_zh: 面向人群特定脑图谱的跨生命周期研究
abstract: A study of the largest available Chinese lifespan-wide structural neuroimaging dataset (comprising 43,037 participants aged 0–100 years) established population-specific brain charts, revealing developmental trajectories that diverge from those of predominantly white populations. These tailored charts improved typical phenotypic prediction and better captured disease-related deviations, advancing equitable precision neuroscience.
abstract_zh: 一项基于最大规模的中国跨生命周期结构神经影像数据集（涵盖0至100岁的43,037名参与者）的研究，建立了人群特定的脑图谱，揭示了与以白人为主的人群不同的发育轨迹。这些定制图谱提高了典型表型预测的准确性，并更好地捕捉了疾病相关偏差，推动了公平的精准神经科学研究。
